teaser.en: The seaside futswe: a rough-leaved, yellow-flowered daisy that sprawls over the sand just above the tide.
teaser.sw: Futswe wa pwani: ua la jamii ya alizeti lenye majani makwaruzo na maua ya manjano, linalotanda mchangani juu kidogo ya mpaka wa maji kujaa.
teaser.dg: *Futswe ra pwani*: mmea wenye makodza ganayokaraza na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano dza ga *daisy*, unaotandazika dzulu ya mtsanga, dzulu tu ya phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika.

summary.en: Futswe ra pwani is a sprawling yellow daisy of the beach and coastal scrub. Digo people name it after the farm weed futswe and add 'of the seaside' for where it grows.
summary.sw: Futswe ra pwani ni mmea wa jamii ya alizeti (daisy) wenye maua ya manjano unaotanda ufukweni na vichakani pwani. Wadigo wameupa jina la gugu la shambani futswe na kuongeza 'wa pwani' kwa sababu ya mahali unapoota.
summary.dg: *Futswe ra pwani* ni mmea unaotandazika wenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano dza ga *daisy*, wa mtsanga wa pwani na wa vitsaka vya pwani. Adigo anauiha kpwa dzina ra *futswe*, mbondo ya mindani, na anaenjereza 'ra pwani' kpwa sababu ya phatu unaphomera.

about.en: Futswe ra pwani is a scrambling, somewhat woody perennial herb that spreads over sand and low scrub. Its opposite leaves are rough to the touch, like fine sandpaper, with toothed edges. Small yellow daisy heads stand on stalks, often in pairs, which is what *biflora* ('two-flowered') refers to. The small fruits are hard and can float, which helps the plant spread along coastlines.
about.sw: Futswe ra pwani ni mmea mdogo wa kudumu, wenye ugumu kiasi kama wa mti, unaojivuta na kutanda juu ya mchanga na vichaka vifupi. Majani yake yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana ni makwaruzo yakiguswa, kama msasa laini, na yana meno kingoni. Vichwa vidogo vya maua ya manjano husimama juu ya vikonyo, mara nyingi viwili viwili, na hiyo ndiyo maana ya *biflora* ('maua mawili'). Matunda yake madogo ni magumu na yanaweza kuelea, jambo linalousaidia mmea kuenea kando ya pwani.
about.dg: *Futswe ra pwani* ni mmea unaoambala, wenye mihi migumu chidide, unaokala kpwa myaka minji, na unatandazika dzulu ya mtsanga na dzulu ya vitsaka vifupi. Makodzage ganamera jozi-jozi ganalolana, ganakaraza uchigaguta, dza msasa wa tembe ndide, na gana meno kanda-kanda. Vitswa vidide vya maruwa ga rangi ya mandano, dza vya *daisy*, vinaima dzulu ya milita, mara nyinji viiri-viiri; ndiyo mana ya *biflora* ('maruwa mairi'). Matundage madide ni magumu na ganaweza kuelea madzini, na kpwa njira ihi mmea unaenea kanda-kanda ya pwani.

where.en: It grows on the seashore: on sandy beach crests, at the edge of coastal bushland and among rocks just above the high-water mark. It is found along coasts across the Indian and Pacific Oceans.
where.sw: Hukua ufukweni: kwenye vilele vya fukwe za mchanga, pembezoni mwa vichaka vya pwani na katikati ya miamba juu kidogo ya mpaka wa maji kujaa. Hupatikana kando ya pwani za Bahari ya Hindi na Bahari ya Pasifiki.
where.dg: Unamera pwani: dzulu ya vidzulu vya mtsanga wa pwani, kanda-kanda ya vitsaka vya pwani na kahi ya mawe, dzulu tu ya phatu madzi ga kuodzala ganaphofika. Unaphahikana kanda-kanda ya pwani za Bahari ya Hindi na za Bahari ya Pasifiki.

culture.en: The name follows a common Digo pattern. *Futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*) is a familiar creeping herb of farms, and this plant is seen as its seaside counterpart. Pakia notes that adding *pwani*, 'sea', marks plants that grow on the shore, or at least nearer the coast than a related plant, as in *mkungu wa pwani*.
culture.sw: Jina hili linafuata mtindo wa kawaida wa Kidigo. *Futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*) ni mmea mdogo unaotambaa unaojulikana sana mashambani, na mmea huu unaonekana kuwa mwenzake wa pwani. Pakia anaeleza kwamba kuongeza *pwani*, 'bahari', huonyesha mimea inayoota ufukweni, au angalau karibu zaidi na pwani kuliko mmea unaohusiana nao, kama katika *mkungu wa pwani*.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rinalunga njira ya kawaida ya Adigo ya kuiha mimea. *Futswe* (*Asystasia gangetica*) ni mmea unaoambala unaomanyikana sana mindani, na Adigo anauona mmea uhu kukala ni *futswe* wa pwani. Pakia anaandika kukala kuenjereza *pwani*, 'bahari', kunaonyesa mimea inayomera pwani, au dzagbwe phephi na pwani kuriko mmea wanjina wa jamii mwenga, dza *mkungu wa pwani*.

names.en: Digo: *futswe ra pwani*, 'futswe of the seaside', and *nchidoka*. Pakia cites *nchidoka* among plant names whose *n-* prefix seems to mark the female gender, but he gives no meaning for the rest of the word. Mgombato records *futswe* itself as *Asystasia gangetica*, Swahili *kichwamangwo*. Elsewhere this plant is called sea daisy; Pakia gives no English name.
names.sw: Kidigo: *futswe ra pwani*, 'futswe wa pwani', na *nchidoka*. Pakia anataja *nchidoka* miongoni mwa majina ya mimea ambayo kiambishi chake *n-* kinaonekana kuashiria jinsi ya kike, lakini hatoi maana ya sehemu iliyobaki ya neno. Mgombato inarekodi *futswe* yenyewe kama *Asystasia gangetica*, kwa Kiswahili *kichwamangwo*. Kwingineko mmea huu unaitwa *sea daisy*; Pakia hatoi jina la Kiingereza.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *futswe ra pwani*, '*futswe* ra pwani', na *nchidoka*. Pakia anaandika *nchidoka* kahi ya madzina ga mimea ambago mwandzo wa *n-* unaonekana kuonyesa kukala mmea ni wa chichetu, ela kaandika mana ya seemu yosi yanjina ya neno. Mgombato inaandika kukala *futswe* ni *Asystasia gangetica*, kpwa Chiswahili *kichwamangwo*. Kpwenye vitabu vyanjina mmea uhu unaihwa *sea daisy*; Pakia kaandika dzina ra Chingereza.

reason.sw: Jina jingine la 'wa pwani', kwa gardenia ya ufukweni

reason.sw: Mwenzake unaotambaa kwenye vilele vya fukwe
reason.dg: *Beach morning glory*, mmea wanjina unaoambala dzulu ya mtsanga wa pwani

reason.sw: Mwenzake mwingine wa pwani wa mmea wa bara
reason.dg: *Mzigande wa pwani*, mmea wanjina wa pwani wenye nduguye wa bara
